notes:
SMB inbound; self-serve signup -> early discovery. Primary contact: CTO (Marisol Vega) and lead engineer (Ethan Rhee). Use-case: product Q&A/chat integrated into storefront + backend product-search tool called via function calls. Key problem: streaming JSON mode returns chunked partial objects that break their client-side parser (Node fetch stream). Also function schema mismatch: Redwood function schema uses parameter names like 'query' but their tool expects 'search_term' — causing no-op tool invocations. Observed symptoms: generator finishes but function never invoked; logs show 'no matching function signature'. Repro steps pasted in support ticket: attach example of multipart stream where last chunk missing closing brace.

Call notes (2/24): "We want streaming for UX (progressive answers) but need guaranteed valid JSON frames for downstream consumer. Can't ship a production widget that fails JSON.parse intermittently." CTO asks about retry/fallback and cost impact. Priya suggested using JSON mode + end-of-stream envelope or using function-calling (non-stream) as a stopgap.

Engineering notes: - Likely causes: chunk boundary splitting JSON token, client not buffering until complete object; or model returning text outside function call schema. Asked them to try SDK streaming helper (v0.10) that emits complete frames and to ensure function schema param aliases include 'search_term' and 'query'. Sent sample schema and Node fetch example in Drive link. They said they'll try patching client parser and retest. If persists, escalate and capture raw stream for Redwood runtime team.
